step_by_step_reasoning: The whiteboard architecture shows a metadata management layer on the left and a centralized data lake ecosystem in the middle and right. On the top left, a frontend request ('F.E') triggers EKS ('Meta Manager'), which interacts bidirectionally with Elasticsearch/Neo4j (OpenSearch) for metadata store/discovery and manages external 'Multiple Data Sources' (OnPremDC). In the center data lake box, data streams between Multiple Data Sources and Kafka (MSK), which writes into S3 Data Lake. EMR processes data stored in S3 and interacts bidirectionally with S3 as well as external Applications (ThirdParty). Finally, curated data flows from S3 to RDS and from EMR to Vertica (ThirdParty) for consumption by Data Analysts/Data Scientists (UserCompanyDeveloper).
